structured_output.title: Renewal timestamp metric help text fix touches Prometheus-scraped cert-manager
structured_output.content: The environment sets prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled and prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort, so cert-manager metrics are probably scraped, including certmanager_certificate_renewal_timestamp_seconds. The release note describes only a fix to that metric's help text: the old text said the value was relative to expiration time, and the corrected text says it is Unix epoch time. The evidence doesn't say the metric's values change, so the main risk is dashboards or alerts built on the old, wrong description. The operator should check any dashboards, alert rules or recording rules that use certmanager_certificate_renewal_timestamp_seconds and confirm they treat the value as a Unix epoch timestamp.
